basic_details.job_title: ICMR NIRBI Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 4 Posts

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: 09.11.2026 (within 30 days from the date of publication)
important_dates.interview_date: To be intimated later to shortlisted candidates

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit is not exceeding 56 years of age as on the last date of receipt of application.

qualification.details: Note: Departmental officers (ICMR employees) shall not be eligible for deputation.

selection_process: The selection process comprises the shortlisting of candidates followed by an interview (offline/online) at ICMR-NIRBI
how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form from Annexure-I of the official notification.
Fill out the application form with accurate details and attach your mobile number and email ID.
Gather all requisite documents including educational certificates, experience certificates, and APARs of preceding five years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26).
Ensure the application is routed through the proper channel via your parent cadre or employing department.

Obtain Cadre Clearance, Vigilance Clearance, Integrity Certificate, No Objection Certificate (NOC), and a list of major/minor penalties imposed during the last ten years from your Cadre Controlling Authority.
Place the complete application and enclosures inside an envelope.
Superscribe the envelope clearly with "Application for the post of Assistant (on Deputation) at ICMR-NIRBI, Kolkata".

Post or deliver the application package to: The Sr. Administrative Officer, ICMR-National Institute for Research in Bacterial Infections, P-33, C.I.T. Road, Scheme-XM, Beliaghata, Kolkata-700010, West Bengal within 30 days of publication (i.e. up to 09.11.2026).
important_instructions: Canvassing of any kind will result in disqualification. Candidates must not have been convicted by any Court of Law. Applications received other than through the proper channel or after the last date will be summarily rejected. ICMR-NIRBI, Kolkata reserves the right to terminate the deputation at any time without assigning reasons. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. The initial period of deputation is two years, extendable by another year or based on administrative requirements. Candidates must regularly visit the official ICMR-NIRBI website for updates, corrigenda, or addendums.

content_sections.heading: ICMR NIRBI Assistant Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There are a total of 4 vacancies available for the post of Assistant.

content_sections.heading: ICMR NIRBI Assistant Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Note: Departmental officers (ICMR employees) shall not be eligible for deputation.

rows.qualification_required: Officers from Central/State Govt./Autonomous Body/PSU holding analogous post and possessing minimum three years Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from a recognized University/Institution and having working knowledge of Computer (MS Office/power point); OR Upper Division Clerk in Level 4 (Rs. 25500-81100) with 10 years of regular service in the grade and possessing minimum three years Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from a recognized University/Institution and having working knowledge of Computer (MS Office/power point).
